name: Caddo Parish, LA
findings: Caddo Parish has 995 nonprofit organizations. 313 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 240 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Caddo Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
